items.title: 12-Year-Old GitLab Vulnerability Allows Remote Code Execution on Self-Managed Server
items.description: GitLab has released urgent security updates for a critical vulnerability that could let attackers run code on self-managed servers without logging in. Tracked as CVE-2026-110264, the flaw carries the maximum CVSS score of 10.0 and affects both GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition. The company published the fixes on October 21, 2026. items.title: GoDaddy Revoking 404,607 TLS Certificates Following Compliance Failures
items.description: GoDaddy launched a mass revocation of 404,607 SSL/TLS certificates after finding that issued certificates did not match its published certificate policies. The company missed its required revocation deadline, creating a second compliance issue. An updated customer notice says the incorrectly issued certificates were revoked on October 21, 2026. items.title: Node.js Releases Security Updates to Fix High-Severity TLS, DNS, and Brotli Vulnerabilities
items.description: Node.js has released security updates for its 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x branches to address ten vulnerabilities, including four high-severity flaws affecting DNS lookups, TLS certificate checks, and Brotli decompression. The supplied release details identify 26.12.1, 24.22.1, and 22.23.4 as the patched versions. The most serious potential outcome is remote code execution through the Brotli decoder.…
